channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Alpaca Festival 2027: Open Call for Pattern-Based Performances, Workshops and Talks (Sheffield, UK)
item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

item.title: Follow Fluxus: After Fluxus Scholarship 2026/27 (EUR 10,000, 3-month studio and exhibition, Wiesbaden)
item.description: Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden, with the City of Wiesbaden · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 grant plus a rent-free 70.88 sqm live/work studio at the Kunsthaus Wiesbaden for three months and a follow-up exhibition at the Nassauischer Kunstverein. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: EMMA Kreativzentrum Pforzheim: Designers in Residence 2027 (EUR 1,000/month, 3 months)
item.description: EMMA Kreativzentrum Pforzheim (City of Pforzheim), with Pforzheim University and Design Center Baden-Wuerttemberg · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month (EUR 3,000 over the residency), plus material costs covered, free accommodation and reimbursed travel. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP x Sumud: Residency for Palestinian Artists in Helsinki, Spring 2027 (EUR 3,600 working grant)
item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: HIAP: Ukraine Solidarity Residencies Programme 2027 (Finland)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme) and partner residencies · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,200 per month (EUR 1,200 to 3,600 depending on residency length), plus free living and working space, one return trip from the artist's home, and a small access budget for disabled artists. No application fee.

item.title: Realities in Transition RiT2 Open Call #3: Uncharted Grounds, a VRChat world residency with L.E.V. Festival (EUR 10,000 fee plus up to EUR 15,000 production)
item.description: Realities in Transition (RiT2, Creative Europe), with L.E.V. Festival · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 gross artist fee per selected artist (paid in three instalments) plus up to EUR 15,000 gross production budget shared among the team. No travel or accommodation included. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Dance Ireland Residencies, Spring/Summer 2027 (DanceHouse Dublin, EUR 750 per week)
item.description: Dance Ireland · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · EUR 750 per week stipend plus subsidised studio space. An extra EUR 750 bursary for artists living more than 100 km from Dublin (accommodation or travel). One Disabled Dance Artist residency with a EUR 750 bursary and an access budget. No application fee.

item.title: Schaufler Residency@TU Dresden 2027 (six-month art and science residency, Energy Cultures in Transition)
item.description: Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden (TUD Dresden University of Technology and The Schaufler Foundation) · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · Fellowship of EUR 3,000 net per month for six months (EUR 18,000), plus a production grant of up to EUR 10,000 for a solo exhibition at the TUD University Gallery in autumn 2027, a studio on campus and help finding accommodation. No application fee.

item.title: Athens Digital Arts Festival 2027 (23rd edition): Open Call "It's Alive..."
item.description: Athens Digital Arts Festival (ADAF) · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · NO PUBLISHED CASH, listed under the desk's festival exception (festival calls with a firm deadline may be added without a cash amount). No entry fee. Postal submission costs and artwork transport are at the artist's expense unless agreed otherwise.

item.title: ART4MENTAL open call for artists: VR content for mental-health support (EUR 5,000 sub-grants)
item.description: ART4MENTAL (Creative Europe project) · deadline 11 Nov 2026 · Sub-grant of up to EUR 5,000 per artist for 20 selected artists (EUR 100,000 pool), plus VR training, mentorship, a residency in the Ukrainian Carpathians and exhibition opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: Frame Contemporary Art Finland: Mobility and Production Grants (October 2026 round)
item.description: Frame Contemporary Art Finland · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Mobility grants EUR 250 to 5,000; production grants EUR 2,500 to 8,000. No application fee.

item.title: workspacebrussels Studio Residencies, August to December 2027
item.description: workspacebrussels · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · EUR 750 flat fee per selected project for travel and lunch costs, plus a free studio for one to two weeks, basic technical equipment in some studios, communal lunches and optional work sharings. No application fee.

item.title: IKSV Ortaklasa: EU-Turkiye Cultural Partnership Call for Proposals 2026
item.description: Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (IKSV) with Culture Action Europe, funded by the European Commission · deadline 18 Dec 2026 · EUR 60,000 to 120,000 per project (total budget EUR 890,000); grants cover 70 to 95 percent of eligible costs, with a minimum 5 percent cash co-financing. Project duration 9 to 12 months.

item.title: Kulturstiftung des Bundes: General Project Funding, January 2027 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Kulturstiftung des Bundes (German Federal Cultural Foundation) · deadline 31 Jan 2027 · No fixed ceiling, but total project costs must exceed EUR 50,000 to be eligible. The Foundation allocates up to EUR 10 million per year across this line. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be secured from own capital and/or third-party funding. No application fee.

item.title: Ars Gratia Artis World Film Festival 2027 (Arboga, Sweden)
item.description: Dorobantu Film & Television · deadline 19 Apr 2027 · Great Ars Award for Best Film: SEK 4,000 plus a physical trophy; Best Feature Film and Best Short Film: SEK 2,000 plus an official diploma each. All cash prizes are split equally between director and producer and paid within six months after the festival. Submission fees apply: USD 5 to 18 depending on category and deadline tier.

item.title: Culture Moves Europe: Call for Individual Mobility 2026-2027
item.description: Creative Europe (Culture Moves Europe), implemented by the Goethe-Institut · deadline 30 Apr 2027 · EUR 85 per day of project implementation, plus travel allowance of EUR 400 (under 5,000 km) or EUR 800 (from 5,000 km). Top-ups where applicable: green mobility EUR 400, overseas countries and territories / outermost regions EUR 175, family EUR 200 per child under 18, visa EUR 120. Accessibility support: EUR 30 per day plus actual cost or fixed allowance for personal assistance or sign language interpretation. No application fee.

item.title: Schlossmediale Call for Art Residency 2027 (Schloss Werdenberg, Switzerland)
item.description: Schlossmediale Werdenberg · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CHF 4,000 grant per resident, plus CHF 1,000 for travel, transport and meals, up to CHF 1,000 for material costs, and accommodation in a shared house (individual rooms). Three residencies awarded.

item.title: Ernest Albert Invitational 2027: Artistic Development Residency at Cas-co x Kunsthal Mechelen
item.description: Cas-co, Leuven and Kunsthal Mechelen · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · EUR 6,080 total including VAT: an artist fee of EUR 1,100 per month, a transportation allowance of EUR 120 per month, and a one-time production budget of EUR 1,200. Kunsthal Mechelen provides additional artist and production fees for the exhibition. No application fee.

item.title: Art Explora x Cité internationale des arts Residency, 7th Call (Paris)
item.description: Art Explora Foundation and Cité internationale des arts · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month living stipend plus up to EUR 3,000 production grant, a furnished live-work studio of around 50 m2 at the Cité internationale des arts, round-trip travel to Paris and curatorial mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: Transatlantic Stars Visual Arts Program 2027: US residencies for EU artists
item.description: European Union Delegation to the United States · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Fully funded: each selected artist receives a living stipend and a materials budget (amounts not published), plus airfare, visa assistance, on-site lodging, studio space and access to host facilities. Six placements. Free to apply.

item.title: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen: Call for Films, 73rd Festival (2027)
item.description: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen (International Short Film Festival Oberhausen) · deadline 18 Jan 2027 · International Competition: Grand Prize of the City of Oberhausen EUR 8,000, Principal Prize EUR 4,000, Promotional Prize EUR 1,500, plus a European Film Awards short film nomination. German Competition: EUR 5,000 main prize, EUR 1,500 promotional, EUR 2,500 3sat Emerging Talent Prize (with purchase offer), EUR 1,000 ZONTA Prize for a female filmmaker. NRW Competition: EUR 1,000 and EUR 500 prizes, plus NRW Ministry prizes of EUR 5,000 and EUR 3,000, FIPRESCI Prize, EUR 2,000 Ecumenical Jury Prize, EUR 750 WDR Westart Audience Jury Prize. Children's and Youth: several EUR 1,000-1,500 prizes and an ECFA Short Film Award nomination. Prizes go to the directors. SUBMISSION FEE: first five submissions per submitter are free; EUR 20 handling fee per film from the sixth.

item.title: Region Ile-de-France: Programme regional de residences d'artistes (arts plastiques, numeriques et urbains), March 2027 session
item.description: Region Ile-de-France · deadline 18 Mar 2027 · EUR 2,400 gross per month bourse to the artist for a residency of 2 to 10 months; the programme also funds the host venue's mediation programme. No application fee.

item.title: La Scam: Bourses Brouillon d'un reve Sonore (Radio and Podcast Authors, rolling)
item.description: La Scam (Societe civile des auteurs multimedia) · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 2,500 to EUR 6,000 per bourse, paid directly to the author 4 to 5 weeks after contract signing; over EUR 830,000 is distributed annually across all Brouillon d'un reve categories. No application fee.

item.title: Propuestas VEGAP 2026: XXX Call for Visual Creation Grants
item.description: VEGAP (Visual Entidad de Gestion de Artistas Plasticos), Fondo Asistencial y Cultural · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 100,000 total: 20 grants of EUR 5,000 each. No application fee.

item.title: City of Timisoara Project Centre: Mobilities for Cultural Professionals 2026
item.description: Centrul de Proiecte al Municipiului Timisoara · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Maximum RON 7,500 per national mobility; maximum RON 10,000 per international mobility. Non-reimbursable, with a required co-funding of at least 1% of the project budget. No application fee.

item.title: Fondation Vocatio: Bourse Vocatio 2027 (EUR 10,000 for young talents in Belgium)
item.description: Fondation Vocatio · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 bourse per laureate, funding a concrete personal project (equipment, production, training). No application fee.

item.title: AFTER THE PALACE: Resonance 2026 Video Mapping Contest (Krakow)
item.description: University of the National Education Commission in Krakow (unLoc project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Cash prizes: PLN 10,000 (~EUR 2,340) first place, PLN 6,000 second, PLN 3,000 third; the jury may award additional honorary distinctions or redistribute the pool. Free to enter, submission is exclusively digital.

item.title: Finnish Cultural Foundation: October Round 2026 (all fields of art and science)
item.description: Finnish Cultural Foundation (Suomen Kulttuurirahasto) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Around EUR 49 million awarded annually across roughly 2,100 grants; recent October rounds have averaged over 450 working and project grants covering one or more years, with working grants extending up to four years. No application fee.

item.title: Kunststiftung Sachsen-Anhalt: Arbeitsstipendien and Projektfoerderung (round 2/2026)
item.description: Kunststiftung des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · Arbeitsstipendium: EUR 1,500 per month for 3 or 6 months. Projektfoerderung: amounts per project budget. No application fee.

item.title: ACC Galerie Weimar: 33rd International Studio Program 2027, On Absence
item.description: ACC Galerie Weimar and the City of Weimar · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · EUR 1,100 per month stipend for four months, plus a rent-free furnished studio apartment and a group exhibition the following year. No application fee.

item.title: Auslandsstipendien von Bund und Laendern 2028 (Villa Massimo, Casa Baldi, Venice, Paris)
item.description: Kulturstiftung der Laender / BKM (German federal and state governments) · deadline 15 Dec 2026 · Villa Massimo: EUR 3,000/month; Casa Baldi: EUR 3,000/month; Deutsches Studienzentrum Venedig: EUR 1,534/month; Paris: approx. EUR 1,500/month. Accommodation and studio provided at all locations. No application fee.

item.title: Stiftung Kunstfonds: KUNSTFONDS_Publikation 2027 (up to EUR 24,000)
item.description: Stiftung Kunstfonds · deadline 15 Jan 2027 · Up to EUR 24,000 per publication project; a minimum 10% own contribution is required and may come from third parties. No application fee.

item.title: Flemish Government: Kunstendecreet beurzen voor kunstenaars (March 2027 round)
item.description: Flemish Government, Department of Culture, Youth and Media (Kunstendecreet) · deadline 15 Mar 2027 · Beurs opkomend talent (emerging talent): EUR 7,500 lump sum for 1 year. Beurs bewezen talent (proven talent): EUR 12,000 per year, for 1, 2 or 3 years. No application fee.
